summary: Candidate is a distinct micro_skill for general-purpose value interpolation across multiple types (numeric, color, string, array, object). Peer candidates are specialized children: 'Interpolate smooth rainbow gradient' targets color interpolation only (task_family: color_interpolation), and 'Apply Custom Property Tweens During Transition' targets animation-context tweens (task_family: animation_control, stage: execution). Existing skills are unrelated (Spring Boot migration, Flink buffer tuning). Candidate has unique semantic identity as a foundational interpolation utility, supported by d3-interpolate evidence.
